summary: Feature-gated dispatch helper. First invokes the virtual method at vtable offset +28 on the interface object pointed to by global dword_7CD8C0, passing argument 23, as an availability gate. If the gate returns zero, returns zero immediately without dispatching. Called from AutoJoinRetryLoop and MultiplayerSessionJoinHandler, consistent with multiplayer session-join setup.
